pipeline.transform: Registered zone PNG masters generate the complete 12-tile base with tools/import_zone_masters.py. A declared unexplored master supplies the entire base while its explored pair supplies color through native reveal alpha; otherwise native color is retained only beneath a declared active-zone fog footprint. City, continent, cosmic world, and battleground base tiles are generated from registered full-map masters with tools/slice_full_map.py
